info.title: kestrel operator
info.summary: The boundary a Client reaches a control plane over.
info.description: Server-sent events down, JSON up, plain HTTP. It authenticates nobody, so the control plane serves it on a listener of its own, apart from the link, and binds that listener to loopback unless told otherwise. A remote control plane is reached through a tunnel. Every operation refuses with 403, and does nothing, a request whose Host is not loopback, or whose Origin, when it sends one, is not exactly http:// followed by that Host.

get.summary: List one directory of a Workspace's live Instance.
get.description: Asked of the Instance's supervisor over the link and answered live; never written to the Store, Transcript or Event log. Each entry is marked tracked, untracked or ignored. A directory past 5,000 entries is truncated, and `total` says how many it holds. Symlinks are resolved, and a path outside the Workspace's checkouts is refused. Concurrent identical reads share one request, and an answer is reused for about 5 s.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: `<repo>/<path>`. Absent or empty lists the Workspace's repositories.

get.summary: Read one file of a Workspace's live Instance.
get.description: Asked of the Instance's supervisor over the link and answered live; never written to the Store, Transcript or Event log. UTF-8 text up to 1 MiB is answered inline as JSON. A binary file, a file past 1 MiB, or a `raw` read is streamed as `application/octet-stream`, unbuffered and with no cap, and never shared or cached. Symlinks are resolved, and a path outside the Workspace's checkouts is refused.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: `<repo>/<path>`.

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: Stream the bytes even when the file is text under the inline bound.

get.summary: Read the Organization's queue: the limits, their occupancy, the queued Sessions in dispatch order, and the Waiting Sessions.
get.description: Queued Sessions appear in the order they were enqueued. Each one ready for dispatch apart from the shared Active-Work Slot pool is numbered from 1; one that is not carries no number and names every reason that holds it, derived by the rules dispatch applies. Waiting Sessions follow, unnumbered, with any held input and why their next turn has not started. Nothing is estimated. The Active-Work Slot limit is the one the dispatching work role recorded, or no work role is dispatching; the pool belongs to the control plane and every Organization shares it, so other Organizations' occupants are counted and never named. Reading changes nothing.

get.summary: Stream a Workspace's Transcript.
get.description: Replays every entry after `Last-Event-ID`, in order, each as an `entry` event whose id is the cursor that resumes after it. A read that follows then stays open and delivers entries as they are appended; the stream ends with an `end` event once the Workspace is sealed, or at once for a read that does not follow. A cursor that names no position in this Transcript is refused rather than silently restarting the walk.

parameters.description: The Workspace whose Transcript is read, by its generated name, its identifier, any unambiguous prefix of its identifier, or `latest`.

parameters.name: follow
parameters.description: Whether to stay open for entries appended after the ones already recorded.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The id of the last entry this reader was delivered. Absent means from the beginning.

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Comma-separated Transcript kinds. The cursor advances across every examined seq, including omitted kinds.

200.description: The stream is open. Each event carries an entry or the end of the stream as its data, and its kind as its event name.

get.summary: Stream the Organization's change notices.
get.description: Opens with an `open` event, then sends a `change` event naming each Workspace, Session or queue that changed, at most once per resource per 250 ms. A notice says what changed, never what it changed to. No event carries an id and `Last-Event-ID` is ignored: a notice is a hint to refetch, never a cursor. A subscriber that falls behind the bounded buffer is sent `resync` instead of a silent gap.

200.description: The stream is open. `open` and `resync` mean every subscribed view must be refetched; `change` names one resource.

Refused.description: The control plane refused the request. 400 is a request it could not read; 404 is a name or reference that resolves to no record, or to more than one; 409 and 422 are an operation it declined; 503 is a control plane that could not answer; 504 is an Instance that did not answer a read within 10 s.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before asking again. Present on a 503 only when the database was busy, which asking again can clear.

PayloadReference.description: A body field exceeding 65536 bytes, fetched under its owning Workspace; message, thought and brief text use raw UTF-8, while plans, batched messages and tool input/results use compact JSON.

path.description: The directory listed, or empty for the Workspace's repositories.

total.description: How many entries the directory holds, including any not listed.

git.description: Absent for a repository in the Workspace's list of them.

max_live_instances.description: The most active, idle, or held Instances this Organization may keep live. Null means unbounded.

repositories.description: The repositories the work happens against, in order.

model.description: The model it works with. Absent or null names none, and the Harness's own default is the answer.

brief.description: The Brief the Workspace starts with, handed to the agent exactly as given.

credentials.description: Provider Credentials the Organization holds from this start on, each replacing any it holds under the same variable.

created.description: Whether the start declared it, rather than finding it declared.

Opened.description: A Workspace and the first Session its open enqueued, in one transaction.

filter.description: A CloudEvents filter of exact, prefix, suffix, all, any, or not.

every.description: A duration such as `1h`, counted from the declaration, in place of a filter.

cron.description: Five fields of minute, hour, day of the month, month and day of the week, such as `0 9 * * 1-5`, in place of a filter or an interval.

zone.description: The IANA time zone a cron expression is read in, such as `America/New_York`.

on_open_workspace.description: What a firing that correlates to an open Workspace does: continues its waiting Session, or starts a new Session with this Trigger's Agent. Absent continues.

admits_outsiders.description: Whether the filter fires for Events from people outside the Organization.

applied.description: Whether a trigger file declared it, rather than flags.

integration.description: The GitHub Integration the issue is read through; named with `issue`.

issue.description: Render against the Event a dispatch of this issue would record, recording nothing. Excludes `event`.

declared.description: A trigger file, to test the Trigger as it declares it rather than as it was applied.

would.description: What a firing would do now: open a Workspace, continue the waiting Session of the open one it correlates to, start a new Session there, or ignore a correlation miss.

triggers.description: Each Trigger the file applies, keyed by its name; `{}` removes every Trigger a file applied.

work_role.description: What the dispatching work role recorded when it started, or null while no work role is dispatching.

limit.description: The Active-Work Slot limit a dispatching work role recorded, or null while no work role is dispatching.

occupied.description: Every Working Session on the control plane: the pool it counts against is shared by every Organization.

elsewhere.description: Occupants of other Organizations, counted and never named.

limit.description: The Organization's live Instance limit, or null when unbounded.

count.description: The Instances counted against it, idle ones retained for Unpublished Work included.

counted.description: The counted Instances that can be named.

position.description: The Session's place among the ready ones, numbered from 1 in enqueue order. Null while any reason holds it.

reasons.description: Every current reason it has not started: dependencies, subscription_profile, instance_archiving or live_instance_limit. Empty for a ready Session, whose only wait is the Active-Work Slot pool.

WaitingSession.description: A Session between turns. It holds no Active-Work Slot and has no place in the queue; messages behind a working turn are Workspace state, not these.

pending_since.description: When the oldest input held for its next turn arrived, or null while it is only waiting for a turn.

reasons.description: Why its next turn has not started: active_work_slots, subscription_profile or ahead. Empty without held input.

QueueReason.description: One reason a Session has not started, for a Client to phrase.

sessions.description: The blocking Sessions that have not ended successfully.

session.description: The Working Session holding the serialized profile.

instance.description: The idle Instance being archived, or that dispatch will archive, to make room.

limit.description: The Organization's live Instance limit, reached with no idle Instance known recoverable.
The Active-Work Slot limit, every slot occupied.

sessions.description: This Organization's earlier input and queued work a freed slot goes to first.

branch.description: Omitted, a branch of the Workspace's own. A continuation runs on the branch of the Workspace it continues.

continues.description: The sealed Workspace this one carries on from, by its generated name, its identifier, any unambiguous prefix of its identifier, or `latest`.

model.description: The model the first Session runs on. Omitted, the Agent's, then the Harness's default.

brief.description: The Brief the Workspace starts with, handed to the agent exactly as given. Omitted, the first Session waits for its first message to become the Brief.

participant.description: The name the Brief is written under. Omitted, its source is the operator and no one joins.
The person posting, by declared name. Trimmed, 1 to 64 characters with no control characters, and never the name of an Agent in the Organization.

instance.description: The Instance its Sessions execute on, while one is kept.

held.description: Why its Instance is held for work that exists nowhere else, if it is.

started_by.description: The Event a firing opened it for, or the Brief's author an operator opened it with. Null when neither names anyone.

pull_requests.description: One per repository fixed on the Workspace, in the checkout's order.

secret.description: The secret a sender presents as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`.

carries.description: The directions it carries. Absent means inbound.

payload_fields.description: Fields containing payload references; absent means every content field is inline.

payload_fields.description: Fields containing payload references; absent means every content field is inline.

payload_fields.description: Fields containing payload references; absent means every content field is inline.
